create_visual_shape: create a visual shape from a mesh file with custom color and frame position
create_collision_shape: create a collision shape from a mesh file with a custom collision frame position
create_multibody_with_shifted_inertia: create a multi-body object with a shifted inertial frame position to offset the center of mass
load_urdf_plane: load a URDF plane model into the PyBullet simulation environment
step_simulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop that steps the physics engine at 240 Hz
